decision: predict only when both models agree; otherwise abstain
selection_provenance: Designed after inspecting errors on all five existing late splits. Under the corrected numeric label contract, their 15/15 at 15/16 coverage is retrospective and must not be used as confirmation.

confirmation_gate.data: the complete late split of the first physical matrix generated after this policy commit
confirmation_gate.comparison: must not make more errors than packed+visible afterstate or action geometry on covered rows

numeric_label_contract: Continuous outcomes within absolute tolerance 1e-12 are equal; discrete outcomes require exact equality.
replication_conclusion: The model is descriptively better than action geometry across the two corrected evaluations (6/7 versus 3/7), but the second run violated the preregistered zero-error gate. Do not retune on either evaluation run.
